# tiny-chess-01
> Ultra-compact, deterministic UCI chess engine in Python 3.13 (<4 KB) for make.fun tiny-chess-01 ($500 USDC).

## Quick Facts
- **Entrypoint**: `main.py` (3,780 bytes)
- **Language**: Python 3.13 stdlib (`os`, `sys`, `json`, `urllib.request`)
- **Board**: 10x12 rotated mailbox with 180° board flipping
- **Search**: MTD-bi / Negascout zero-width alpha-beta with Iterative Deepening
- **Pruning**: Quiescence search, Null-Move Pruning (R=2), LMR
- **Evaluation**: Procedural PeSTO distance equations + tapered King centralization
- **Budget**: 8,000 nodes/move deterministic limit (zero clocks)
- **Bounty**: https://make.fun/bounty/tiny-chess-01
- **Repo**: https://github.com/Akash1070/tiny-chess-01.git
- **Wallet**: `FkoaEHrqcKmCUjis98bYo7C7wcSgJZ7p8KXifpbLum9j`
